reason: Five verified Workbench interface defects from the round-4 UI audit (findings 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6), each with a vitest that fails on main. Finding 1: terminalViewportCapture.selectedAt compared xterm's getSelectionPosition() range as if it were 1-based, but @xterm/xterm 6.0.0 reports 0-based buffer columns and absolute rows with an exclusive end (verified in jsdom against the installed package: select(2,0,3) gives start {x:2,y:0}, end {x:5,y:0}); the screenshot highlight therefore sat one row up and one column left of the operator's selection and a first-row selection was never highlighted. The two +1 offsets are removed and the fixture uses real coordinates. Finding 2: ExecutionHistory's output effect depended on the selected object, which the 2 s background poll replaced with equal data whenever any execution was active, so the stdout and stderr panes reset to offset 0 and discarded 'Load next 256 KiB' pages on every poll; the effect now keys on the selected id, status and completedAt. Finding 3: WorkbenchBrowser re-ran its eight Tauri listen() registrations on every SessionsPage render because the parent passed an inline onAttachContext and the effect depended on it, on the session and identity objects and on scope; the cleanup unlistened synchronously while the replacements registered asynchronously, so a capture reply, download or traffic event in that gap was lost. The listeners now register once per desktop project and read callbacks, session, identity, api, confirm and scope through refs, and SessionsPage memoizes onAttachContext with useCallback. Finding 4: EditorDebuggerPanel sent setBreakpoints exactly once on the initialized event, so a gutter toggle after launch changed only the marker; while a session is live the current breakpoint set is re-sent whenever it changes, and unrelated renders stay quiet. Finding 6: the autonomous web-test Duration, Tool-call and Request budget inputs stored Number(value) and snapped to 0 when cleared; they now hold the raw text and are parsed with the #415 empty/NaN guard and range validation before createMission. The six vitest files (65 tests) prove each behaviour with controlled promises and fake timers alongside their existing neighbours; npm run build typechecks and bundles.
exclusions: No Python tests: no src/ or tests/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. Playwright: the impact rules match browser-complete through WorkbenchBrowser.tsx, assistant, chat-edit-in-place and provider-thinking through SessionsPage.tsx, and the remaining-ui-components fallback areas desktop-interface and mobile-layout through EditorDebuggerPanel, ExecutionHistory and terminalCapture; all six matched areas are selected as the regression net for the native listener refactor and the SessionsPage callback change. None of those journeys toggles a breakpoint mid-session, pages execution output across a poll, selects terminal text before a screenshot or clears a budget field, so the vitest files are the proof for each defect. No real-browser desktop pass was run in this session. No full suites.
